messages:
ani: Heads-up: onboarding for customer 'atlas-inc' is failing with mixed SCIM 200s but SSO logins returning 400s. Backend shows KMS decrypt errors and a couple of provisioning_audit entries where role bindings didn't match after create. Can we triage?

corey: Oncall here. Please paste logs for both SSO and KMS errors. 400 + decrypt points to either assertion attribute name mismatch or extid signature issues.

ani: Logs: 
```
2026-09-10T08:12:01Z ERROR saml.handler: response invalid_attribute assertion_id=urn:uuid:cc22dd tenant=atlas-inc missing_attr=employeeNumber
2026-09-10T08:12:02Z INFO scim.provisioner: user_create status=201 tenant=atlas-inc user=carol
2026-09-10T08:12:03Z ERROR kms: decrypt failed alias=alias/redwood-enterprise-v5 err="context mismatch" tenant=atlas-inc
2026-09-10T08:12:04Z WARN provisioning_audit: role_bind_failed tenant=atlas-inc user=carol expected_role=reader found_role=null
```

rina: Two separate issues likely: (A) SAML attribute mapping missing employeeNumber causing SSO attribute error, (B) KMS alias mismatch causing extid decrypt and then RBAC bind missing because extid fingerprint changed. Check tenant metadata for extid_wrap_alias and compare to current REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS env.

corey: Quick commands: `psql -c "select extid_wrap_alias from tenants where id='atlas-inc'"` and `echo $REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS` on the provisioner pods. Also ask customer if they recently changed their SAML assertion mapping for employeeNumber.

ani: REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS -> alias/redwood-enterprise-v5. DB extid_wrap_alias -> alias/redwood-enterprise-v3. Customer confirms they recently updated SAML mapping but claims no KMS changes.

rina: That confirms extid rewrap missed for the tenant. Playbook: 1) Pause provisioning queue: `POST /admin/queues/atlas-inc/pause`. 2) Run dry-run rewrap: `scripts/kmstools/rewrap --from alias/redwood-enterprise-v3 --to alias/redwood-enterprise-v5 --tenant atlas-inc --dry-run`. 3) While dry-run runs, fix SAML mapping with customer so employeeNumber is included to avoid SSO failures. 4) Validate normalization: run `python tools/normalize_extid.py --tenant atlas-inc --compare`. 5) Apply rewrap if samples pass, then resume queue. 6) Monitor `provisioning_audit` for unexpected role unbinds.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-401 | Priority: P2 | Tags: saml,scim,kms | Owner: unassigned

corey: Also add a quick guard in the provisioner: when decrypt fails with context mismatch, try previous 2 aliases before surfacing fatal error. We'll follow up with an RFC but enable quick fallback for customer-facing flows.

ani: Dry-run output: `rewrap preview: 94 objects found, 0 preview failures, sample verify OK`. Applying now.

rina: After rewrap, run `SELECT role, COUNT(*) FROM provisioning_audit WHERE tenant='atlas-inc' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY role` to ensure no role drops.

ani: Rewrap applied: 94 rewrapped, 0 errors. Resuming queue at 08:28 UTC.

ops-bot: Queue resumed for atlas-inc at 2026-09-10T08:28:22Z.

corey: Post-change checks: SCIM and SSO successes back to baseline after customer added employeeNumber, no RBAC regressions seen. I'll draft the oncall checklist: detect alias drift (grep for "context mismatch" and compare env vs tenant.extid_wrap_alias), auto-pause rule if >5 mismatches in 2m, and quick rewrap steps.

rina: Postmortem items: 1) ensure KMS alias rotate includes tenant rewrap OR implement alias-fallback verify for N days, 2) add a pre-onboard SAML attribute checklist to ensure required attributes are present, 3) add an audit event when tenant rewraps run so compliance can trace who initiated the change.

ani: Thanks team. Updating INC-2026-401 and will close after CS confirms customer onboarding complete. :white_check_mark:
